newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway expands 12-month T-bill SS47 by NOK 2 bln.
newsitem.headline: Norway expands 12-month T-bill SS47 by NOK 2 bln.

text.p: Norway's central bank said on Wednesday the Finance Ministry was expanding the SS47 treasury bill by two billion crowns through an ordinary auction.
Final date for the tenders was set at 0800 GMT on May 5.
The T-bill was issued on April 7 at 3.5 billion crowns with 500 million crowns reserved for the central bank.
SS47 has a nominal interest rate of 3.70 percent and matures on March 18, 1998.
